B029734.F01.01.B01.Q01.i01.contesto: augmented-reality apps that let customers ‘try’ furniture at home
B029734.F01.01.B01.Q01.i01.testo: A furniture exporter lists “augmented-reality apps that let customers ‘try’ furniture at home”. Which PESTEL family does it belong to?

opzioni.testo: Technological factor
Legal factor
Economic factor
Political factor

sol.spiegazione: “Augmented-reality apps that let customers ‘try’ furniture at home” → technological factor. New tools and digital applications are technological factors.

errori_frequenti.errore: chooses “legal factor”, which instead refers to laws and regulations
chooses “economic factor”, which instead refers to prices, growth, exchange rates
chooses “political factor”, which instead refers to government and trade policy

sol.spiegazione: “Hybrid work increasing demand for home-office furniture” → social factor. Lifestyles and work habits are social factors.

errori_frequenti.errore: chooses “legal factor”, which instead refers to laws and regulations
chooses “political factor”, which instead refers to government and trade policy
chooses “ecological (environmental) factor”, which instead refers to climate, resources, environmental expectations

B029734.F01.04.B01.C01.i01.testo: In the industrial packaging industry 6 firms have these market shares (%): 24, 23, 16, 15, 14, 8. Compute the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI).

sol.spiegazione: HHI = sum of squared shares in percentage points = 24² + 23² + 16² + 15² + 14² + 8² = 1,846: highly concentrated market (thresholds 1,000 and 1,800).

B029734.F01.01.B01.Q05.i01.testo: Which of the following belongs to the category “economic factor”?

opzioni.testo: Sanctions that close an important export market
An ageing population in Europe
Hybrid work increasing demand for home-office furniture
A sharp depreciation of the currency of a key export market

sol.spiegazione: Exchange rates belong to the economic environment. The other options belong to different categories: “Sanctions that close an important export market” → political factor; “An ageing population in Europe” → social factor; “Hybrid work increasing demand for home-office furniture” → social factor.

errori_frequenti.errore: “sanctions that close an important export market” belongs instead to “political factor”
“an ageing population in Europe” belongs instead to “social factor”
“hybrid work increasing demand for home-office furniture” belongs instead to “social factor”

B029734.F01.01.B01.Q05.i02.testo: Pick the example of this category: political factor.

opzioni.testo: EU rules on environmental claims and traceability
Sanctions that close an important export market
An ageing population in Europe
A sharp depreciation of the currency of a key export market

sol.spiegazione: Sanctions are decided by governments: a political factor. The other options belong to different categories: “A sharp depreciation of the currency of a key export market” → economic factor; “An ageing population in Europe” → social factor; “EU rules on environmental claims and traceability” → legal factor.

errori_frequenti.errore: “EU rules on environmental claims and traceability” belongs instead to “legal factor”
“an ageing population in Europe” belongs instead to “social factor”
“a sharp depreciation of the currency of a key export market” belongs instead to “economic factor”

B029734.F01.02.B01.Q01.i01.contesto: firms sharing logistics while competing on the same customers
B029734.F01.02.B01.Q01.i01.testo: “firms sharing logistics while competing on the same customers”: which concept is this?

opzioni.testo: Coopetition
Transient advantage
Industry convergence
Hypercompetition

sol.spiegazione: “Firms sharing logistics while competing on the same customers” → coopetition. Cooperating on one activity and competing on the market is coopetition.

errori_frequenti.errore: chooses “transient advantage”, which instead refers to a portfolio of temporary advantages
chooses “industry convergence”, which instead refers to previously separate industries merging
chooses “hypercompetition”, which instead refers to rapid erosion of advantages by moves and counter-moves

B029734.F01.02.B01.Q01.i02.testo: A strategist observes an electric-car maker whose success depends on charging networks, batteries and incentives. Which concept applies?

opzioni.testo: Coopetition

sol.spiegazione: “An electric-car maker whose success depends on charging networks, batteries and incentives” → business ecosystem. Independent actors must coordinate to deliver a common value proposition: an ecosystem.

B029734.F06.03.B01.C02.i01.testo: A campaign costing €15,000 brings 30 new customers. Each first order is worth €800 with a gross margin of 45%. What is the marketing ROI on the first order?

B029734.F11.01.B01.Q05.i01.testo: Which initiative is an example of ethical responsibility?

opzioni.testo: Refusing to use a legal but misleading sales practice
Healthier food products and financial services for people excluded from credit
Cutting energy, water and packaging while training suppliers to be more productive
Complying with environmental and labour laws

sol.spiegazione: Avoiding unfair but legal practices is ethical responsibility. The other options belong to different categories: “Cutting energy, water and packaging while training suppliers to be more productive” → shared value: productivity in the value chain; “Complying with environmental and labour laws” → legal responsibility; “Healthier food products and financial services for people excluded from credit” → shared value: reconceiving products and markets.

errori_frequenti.errore: “healthier food products and financial services for people excluded from credit” belongs instead to “shared value: reconceiving products and markets”
“cutting energy, water and packaging while training suppliers to be more productive” belongs instead to “shared value: productivity in the value chain”
“complying with environmental and labour laws” belongs instead to “legal responsibility”

opzioni.testo: Investing in local training, infrastructure and suppliers

Avoiding child labour in suppliers' countries where controls are weak
